page.overview:
Who is Eddard Stark?

Lord Eddard Stark, also known as Ned Stark, was the head of House Stark, the Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North, and later Hand of the King to King Robert I Baratheon. He was the son of Lord Rickard Stark, older brother of Benjen and Lyanna Stark, and the younger brother of Brandon Stark. He is the father of Robb, Sansa, Arya, Bran, and Rickon by his wife, Catelyn Tully, and uncle of Jon Snow, whom he raised as his bastard son. He was a dedicated husband and father, a loyal friend, and an honorable lord.

Eddard's execution and revelation of the illegitimacy of Cersei Lannister's children sparked the War of the Five Kings.

Despite his death, Eddard's legacy shaped the future of Westeros in the years that followed. His eldest son Robb was declared the first King in the North since the days of Aegon's Conquest. Although Robb later fell at the Red Wedding, the North's desire for freedom was carried on by Jon's own rise as king following the Battle of the Bastards. Following the Last War, a Great Council in the Dragonpit elected Eddard's last living son, Bran, as the king of the new Six Kingdoms, while his eldest daughter, Sansa, was crowned the Queen in the North.

Eddard Stark was the head of House Stark and Warden of the North, and House Stark is one of the Great Houses of the realm. House Stark rules the region from their seat of Winterfell, and Eddard also held the title Lord of Winterfell.

Also known as: Ned Stark, Ned, Eddard.
